title: CNC CPU Load — High
description: CNC CPU load P080 = {val}% sustained over last {val2} minutes. May cause motion interpolation jitter if load exceeds 90%.
probable_cause: Complex NC program with many small blocks, excessive macro execution, or background task conflict.
diagnostic_steps: Check number of active background tasks
Disable unnecessary data logging during critical cuts
Check for DNC streaming vs. stored program
remedy: Optimise NC program (increase minimum arc chord tolerance). Use stored program instead of DNC stream.
required_action: Complete current cycle then stop. Schedule maintenance within 4 hours.
escalation_path: If CNC-SR-001 is not addressed (complete current cycle then stop. schedule maintenance within 4 hours.), the fault will escalate in this order: CNC-CR-001, then CNC-MD-011. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
